description: Fix pet damage (client never calls AssignPetTarget) and fix crit token exploit (crit window reusable). Two P0 bugs in one feature.
steps: Step 1 - Fix PetController.lua to call AssignPetTarget: In src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/PetController.lua, in the init() method, get a reference to the AssignPetTarget RemoteFunction: self._assignPetTarget = self._remotes:WaitForChild('AssignPetTarget'). Add a tracking table self._serverAssignments = {} to avoid redundant calls.

Step 2 - In PetController:sendPetToAttack(), after line 'self._attackingPets[uniqueId] = destructibleId', add rate-limited server assignment: Only call self._assignPetTarget:InvokeServer(uniqueId, destructibleId) if self._serverAssignments[uniqueId] ~= destructibleId. Then set self._serverAssignments[uniqueId] = destructibleId.

Step 3 - When a pet is cleared from attacking (self._attackingPets[uniqueId] = nil occurrences), also call self._assignPetTarget:InvokeServer(uniqueId, nil) and set self._serverAssignments[uniqueId] = nil. Key locations: the sendPetToAttack coroutine where it returns (destructible destroyed, player too far), cancelAllAttacks(), clearManualTarget(), and the auto-attack loop when a target becomes invalid.

Step 4 - Fix crit token exploit in src/ServerScriptService/Services/ZoneService.lua: In ZoneService.critAttackDestructible(), at line 1881 where the comment says 'we keep the window open so multiple circles can crit within the window', REPLACE that comment with code that CONSUMES the crit window: playerCritWindows[destructibleId] = nil. This ensures each normal click generates exactly ONE crit opportunity.
Step 5 - Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py to regenerate BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx with the fixes.
acceptance_criteria: PetController.init() stores a reference to AssignPetTarget RemoteFunction
PetController:sendPetToAttack() calls AssignPetTarget:InvokeServer(uniqueId, destructibleId) when assignment changes
When pets are cleared from targets (destroyed target, player too far, cancelAllAttacks, clearManualTarget), AssignPetTarget:InvokeServer(uniqueId, nil) is called to clear server assignment
Rate limiting prevents redundant InvokeServer calls (only fires when assignment actually changes)
In ZoneService.critAttackDestructible(), after validating the crit window, the window is consumed (set to nil) BEFORE damage is applied so the token cannot be reused
python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py runs successfully and regenerates BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx
verification: Verify no Python errors in output
Verify BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx file is regenerated (check file modification time or content)
Run: grep -n 'AssignPetTarget' src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/PetController.lua to confirm the remote call is present
Run: grep -n '_serverAssignments' src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/PetController.lua to confirm rate-limiting tracking exists
Run: grep -n 'playerCritWindows\[destructibleId\] = nil' src/ServerScriptService/Services/ZoneService.lua to confirm crit window consumption exists before the damage logic
